column1: # The server this engine's committed answers come from. default records the
# grammar's tapes (spanner/parser, spanner/analysis): the Cloud Spanner
# emulator 1.5.54, released from the source tag v1.5.54 of
# GoogleCloudPlatform/cloud-spanner-emulator, which builds against GoogleSQL
# 2026.01.1 (its MODULE.bazel). googlesql.tm, which the rows are generated
# from through GoogleSQL.g4, is googlesql/parser/googlesql.tm at that GoogleSQL
# tag, beside this file byte for byte, Apache-2.0 (GoogleSQL.LICENSE). The
# emulator reads DDL with a parser of its own.
# The judge revision counts how spanner/spanner-oracle and compatJudge read
# the emulator's answers: 2 reads GoogleSQL's grammar refusals
# (grammar_refusals.go) as rejections.
# parser judges spanner/parser/testdata/compat.tsv at the same emulator
# 1.5.54 release so a judge revision bump rejudges compat.tsv without touching
# the default-pinned tapes.
# parser judge revision 3 classifies GoogleSQL's parse-error fallback
# ("Statement not supported: <Kind>Stmt"), lookahead EXCEPT and duplicate
# DYNAMIC LABEL|PROPERTIES syntax refusals as reject, and re-asks CREATE VIEW
# missing SQL SECURITY with a SQL SECURITY INVOKER stand-in so the view query
# body is parsed.
# parser judge revision 4 judged compat.tsv with a BigQuery ∪ Spanner union
# judge. Revision 5 is the Spanner emulator alone again, with the rev 3 rules:
# this tree is Spanner's grammar, and BigQuery's is bigquery/parser, judged by
# BigQuery itself.
# driver records spanner/driver's tapes from the same emulator release. It is
# a row of its own because the driver's answers are recorded from the service's
# clients and can move with an image bump of their own.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag, judge revision
